content: GRID3 publishes Nigeria Operational Ward Boundaries at multiple versions (v1.0 Dec 2020 all-states, v3.0 Jul 2026 24 states) via data.grid3.org, produced with CIESIN/WorldPop. GRID3 boundaries are explicitly stated as operational-use and not yet fully validated by government authorities -- meaning ward code and geometry can differ from NPC (National Population Commission) or state SDGs/GIS boundary sets for the same nominal ward, and different GRID3 versions themselves disagree for the same ward code as boundaries get revised.
